parameters.name: ApiVersion
parameters.description:
The API version number.

> Call the [DescribeGroupProductions](~~DescribeGroupProductions~~) API to get this parameter.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for requests and responses. The default value is **zh**. Values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: PopCode
parameters.description: The POP CODE of the Alibaba Cloud product API.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member whose perspective the administrator switches to.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type. The default is 0. Values:

- 0: Current Alibaba Cloud account view.

- 1: View of all accounts under the enterprise.
